verdict.rationale: Runway documents an "Agentic creative collaborator" and a first-party Runway MCP that connects it to agents like Claude and ChatGPT, so users can drive it in natural language. Its core generation is also text-prompt driven (e.g., text-to-video). Beyond these one-line mentions, the docs do not describe how far natural-language commands can operate the product. Missing for 10: documentation of what the agentic collaborator can do via natural-language commands (editing, workflow control, account actions), detail on which operations the MCP exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Runway MCP: Connect Runway to agents like Claude and ChatGPT.
Gen-4.5 also supports generating videos from text alone, without requiring an input image.
